rationale: Extend the existing orchestration execution responsibility with a generic bridge that binds active product-compatible context references to the already-declared ProductScope only after the existing governed ProductEntityResolver independently resolves them to the exact same canonical product. The bridge reuses governed context requirements, entity resolution, and InstanceResolutionAttestation contracts; it does not change their semantic algorithms.
supersession_impact: No capability or implementation is superseded. Instance Sufficiency remains the planning authority, ProductEntityResolver remains the identity resolver, and publication-backed evidence resolution remains the downstream evidence authority.
authority_impact: No product or answer authority is added. Unmatched, ambiguous, other-product, policy-only, or provenance-mismatched references remain unattested and therefore fail closed at existing guards. The bridge may only project already-governed identity into existing orchestration attestation and resolved-candidate-reference contracts.
